title: Ethernet AUTOSAR Engineer AVB Developer (107)
description:
Job Description – Ethernet AUTOSAR Engineer **Job Details**

* **Job Title:** Ethernet AUTOSAR Engineer
* **Location:** Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore
* **Experience:** 4–10 Years
* **Employment Type:** Full\-Time
* Job Summary
* We are looking for an experienced **Ethernet AUTOSAR Engineer** with strong expertise in:
* Automotive Ethernet
* AUTOSAR Classic
* AVB (Audio Video Bridging)
* TSN (Time\-Sensitive Networking)
* Embedded Linux / RTOS
* Real\-time networking protocols
* The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, debugging, and validating deterministic Ethernet communication solutions for automotive embedded systems.
* The role involves working with the **AUTOSAR Ethernet Stack, IEEE 802\.1 TSN standards, Embedded Linux/RTOS, and automotive communication protocols**.
* Key Responsibilities
* Design, develop, and maintain Automotive Ethernet communication solutions.
* Develop and integrate AUTOSAR Ethernet Stack components.
* Implement and optimize IEEE 802\.1 TSN standards, including:
* IEEE 802\.1AS – gPTP
* IEEE 802\.1Qav – Credit\-Based Shaper
* IEEE 802\.1Qbv – Time\-Aware Scheduling
* IEEE 802\.1Qbu / IEEE 802\.3br – Frame Preemption
* IEEE 802\.1CB – Frame Replication and Elimination
* Develop, integrate, and debug Ethernet communication stacks on Embedded Linux or RTOS platforms.
* Perform integration and validation of AVB/TSN features in:
* Automotive ECUs
* Gateways
* Ethernet Switches
* End Nodes
* Analyze Ethernet network traffic using:
* Wireshark
* Vector CANoe
* Vector CANalyzer
* Similar protocol analysis tools
* Perform latency measurements and synchronization validation.
* Conduct performance analysis and troubleshoot Ethernet communication issues.
* Collaborate with hardware, system, software, and application teams.
* Ensure deterministic and reliable communication performance.
* Participate in architecture reviews and technical discussions.
* Interact with customers and support technical discussions when required.
* Required Skills – Automotive Ethernet \& Networking
* Strong knowledge of Automotive Ethernet.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP and UDP.
* Strong understanding of VLAN – IEEE 802\.1Q.
* Good understanding of QoS concepts.
* Strong knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking.
* Understanding of Ethernet switching and routing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with automotive Ethernet communication.
* Required Skills – AUTOSAR
* Hands\-on experience with **AUTOSAR Classic Platform**.
* Strong understanding of AUTOSAR Ethernet Stack.
* Experience with:
* Ethernet Interface – EthIf
* Ethernet Driver – Eth
* TCP/IP Stack
* Socket Adapter – SoAd
* Diagnostics over IP – DoIP
* SOME/IP communication
* Understanding of Ethernet communication architecture within AUTOSAR.
* Experience integrating and debugging AUTOSAR Ethernet modules.

AUTOSAR specifically defines EthIf as the standardized interface to the Ethernet bus and Eth as the abstraction layer for the Ethernet controller; SoAd provides the socket\-adaptation layer and DoIP functionality is integrated into the Ethernet communication architecture.

* Required Skills – AVB / TSN
* Hands\-on experience with AVB and/or TSN implementations.
* Strong understanding of:
* gPTP / PTP synchronization
* Traffic shaping
* Traffic scheduling
* Deterministic Ethernet communication
* Network timing and synchronization
* Experience with TSN concepts and implementation.
* Ability to analyze latency, jitter, synchronization, and network performance issues.
* Embedded Software Skills
* Strong programming skills in **C/C\+\+**.
* Experience with:
* Embedded Linux
* Linux Kernel
* RTOS
* Experience in networking stack development.
* Experience with device driver development will be an advantage.
* Good understanding of embedded software architecture and debugging.
* Tools \& Technologies
* Vector CANoe
* Vector CANalyzer
* Wireshark
* Git
* JIRA
* Lauterbach Debugger – Preferred
* Education
* BE / B.Tech / M.Tech in:
* Electronics
* Electrical Engineering
* Computer Science
* Embedded Systems
* Electronics \& Communication
* Or a related technical discipline
* Nice to Have
* Experience with Linux / Android / RTOS development.
* Automotive ECU development experience.
* Experience with Ethernet Switch configuration.
* Experience with Diagnostics over IP (DoIP).
* Experience with SOME/IP.
* Awareness of Functional Safety – ISO 26262\.
* Knowledge of ASPICE processes.
* Previous Automotive domain experience.
* Preferred Experience
* **4–10 years of experience** in Automotive Embedded Software.
* Hands\-on experience with Automotive Ethernet and AUTOSAR.
* Practical experience with AVB and/or TSN implementation and validation.
* Strong debugging and protocol analysis skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ideal Candidate Profile
* Automotive Embedded Software Engineer with strong **AUTOSAR Ethernet** experience.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of **Eth, EthIf, TCP/IP, SoAd, DoIP and SOME/IP**.
* Practical exposure to **AVB/TSN and gPTP/PTP**.
* Strong C/C\+\+ programming and embedded debugging skills.
* Experience with **CANoe/CANalyzer and Wireshark**.
* Automotive ECU, Gateway, Ethernet Switch, or connectivity development experience will be highly preferred.

description:
**Job Description:**

**Shopify Developer \& CRO Executive**

**Location:** Peelamedu, Coimbatore

**Experience:** 1\+ Year

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Work Mode:** On\-site

**Salary:** 25K \- 35K

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Shopify Developer with hands\-on experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) to join our team. The ideal candidate should be capable of developing, customizing, and maintaining Shopify stores while also analyzing website performance and implementing improvements that enhance user experience and increase conversions.

The role requires a combination of strong Shopify development skills, analytical thinking, UX understanding, and a performance\-driven approach.

**Key ResponsibilitiesShopify Development**

* Develop, customize, and maintain Shopify and Shopify Plus websites.
* Customize Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related technologies.
* Create and modify product pages, collection pages, landing pages, cart pages, and other Shopify sections.
* Implement custom functionalities based on business and marketing requirements.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Shopify apps and third\-party integrations.
* Ensure websites are responsive and optimized across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Identify and resolve website bugs, theme issues, app conflicts, and performance issues.
* Optimize Shopify stores for speed, performance, and usability.
* Maintain proper tracking implementation for marketing and analytics platforms where required.

**Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)**

* Analyze website performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Review customer journeys from landing page to checkout and identify areas of friction.
* Optimize product pages, collection pages, landing pages, cart pages, and checkout journeys.
* Recommend and implement improvements to website layout, navigation, CTAs, product presentation, and overall user experience.
* Conduct A/B tests and analyze the impact of website changes.
* Monitor key e\-commerce metrics such as:
* Conversion Rate
* Add\-to\-Cart Rate
* Checkout Initiation Rate
* Cart Abandonment Rate
* Bounce Rate
* Average Order Value
* Use analytics and user\-behaviour data to make data\-driven CRO recommendations.
* Work closely with marketing, design, content, and performance marketing teams to improve campaign landing\-page performance.
* Continuously test and optimize the website to improve customer experience and revenue.

**Required Skills**

* Minimum **1 year of hands\-on experience** working with Shopify.
* Strong understanding of **Shopify themes and Shopify Liquid**.
* Good knowledge of **HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development**.
* Experience with Shopify apps, APIs, and third\-party integrations.
* Understanding of **e\-commerce UX/UI principles and CRO fundamentals**.
* Familiarity with analytics tools such as **Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)** and **Google Tag Manager (GTM)**.
* Ability to analyze website and customer behaviour data.
* Understanding of A/B testing and experimentation.
* Knowledge of website speed and performance optimization.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with multiple teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Shopify Plus.
* Experience with tools such as Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, VWO, or similar behaviour analytics/CRO platforms.
* Basic understanding of SEO.
* Experience creating campaign\-specific and high\-converting landing pages.
* Knowledge of Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversion tracking, and other e\-commerce tracking integrations.
* Experience working with D2C or e\-commerce brands.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is technically strong, analytical, and interested in improving both the functionality and commercial performance of e\-commerce websites. The candidate should be comfortable moving beyond development tasks and actively identifying opportunities to improve customer experience, conversion rates, and online revenue.
